verdict.rationale: MoonPay exposes its on/off-ramp as conventional API endpoints for quotes and sessions, with "our rails" doing the work. The developer only supplies a wallet address or CAIP-19 asset ID, and MoonPay handles payment and delivery. It ships an official TypeScript Web SDK and a React Native SDK, plus an OpenAPI 3.1 spec for generating typed clients in any language. missing for 10: explicit documentation that gas fees, node operation, and on-chain settlement are fully abstracted; official native client libraries beyond JS/TS and React Native (other languages rely on codegen, and the spec was not found at standard probe paths); independent hands-on corroboration of the developer experience.
